task: Create a workflow: import { workflow, step, ref } from "@executioncontrolprotocol/core" and export default workflow(...).run([...]). Start with import — never output the word typescript on its own line. Chain .accepts({...}) and .returns({...}) before .run() when the request defines run input or workflow output. Accepts and returns use object JSON Schema shaped as { type: "object", properties: {...}, required: ["..."] } — required is a sibling array of properties, never nested inside properties. Wire accepts keys with ref("key"), not ref("step.output"). RETURNS property types must match .as values — model *.generate stores an object with text, so type returns as object (never string); chain nested fields with ref("prior.text"). Every step must use a real capability id from the environment summary (prefer step-usable caps such as @executioncontrolprotocol/ollama.generate and @executioncontrolprotocol/test.echo). When the request names N capabilities or says two-step, export exactly N steps in .run([...]). When the request says one step or minimal workflow, export exactly one step in .run([...]). Chain steps with ref("priorStep.output") or ref("priorStep.text") when passing outputs. No EQL — Fluent TypeScript only. Output a single TypeScript module only — no prose outside the export.
